8.​ Add after paragraph 26 and renumber (Edinburgh North & Leith) 
 
Whether AI technology will prove to be as devastating to the job market remains to be 
seen. What cannot be ignored, however, is the vast speculative investment 
surrounding the AI industry. Global spending on AI infrastructure alone is projected to 
reach around $1.7 trillion by 2030, this bubble will reap significant economic misery 
upon its implosion. 
 
CC recommendation: Reject in favour of amendment 7 
 
9.​ Add after paragraph 26 and renumber (London - Bermondsey)  
 
In addition, the race to develop AI capabilities is done at the expense of the 
environment. AI data centres require copious amounts of energy and already 
consume more electricity than a country like Germany, making AI the estimated 5th 
largest consumer of electricity globally. By 2030, AI energy consumption alone could 
outstrip current peak consumption. This will further push up electricity prices, 
increase competition for access to water and see a continued reliance on fossil fuel 
for energy generation. 
 
CC recommendation: Reject 
 
10.​Add after paragraph 26 and renumber (London - Harrow)  
 
Britain is already threatened with a crisis of joblessness. Unemployment has risen to 
5.2% and is expected to rise to 5.4% this year, above levels during the COVID 
pandemic. The real situation is worse than these numbers reveal: 20% of working age 
people are out of work and not looking for work. 2.8 million people are out of work 
because of long term illness. Young workers, who are particularly vulnerable to the 
whims of the labour market, face an unemployment rate of 16.1%. The Bank of 
England has said minimum wage rises and taxes on businesses are to blame. This 
just shows the unaffordability of capitalism, as well as the limits of redistribution 
through legislation and taxation. Socially necessary work goes undone while millions 
of people are thrown on the scrapheap. Workers are forced to fight over diminishing 
low-paid, low-quality jobs while capitalists hoard extreme wealth. 
 
CC recommendation: Accept
